summary: python-bitcoinlib (npm) exfiltrates AWS/SSH/wallet credentials via postinstall
details: Cross-ecosystem typosquat of the PyPI package 'python-bitcoinlib' published on npm. The main entry (index.js) is an empty stub (module.exports = {}); the package's only functionality is a postinstall lifecycle script that runs automatically on npm install. The script reads installer-owned secret files including ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.aws/config, ~/.ssh/id_rsa, ~/.ssh/id_ed25519, ~/.ssh/id_ecdsa, ~/.npmrc, ~/.gitconfig,.env files, the Solana keypair at ~/.config/solana/id.json, and the Ethereum keystore directory. It also walks dotdirectories under $HOME and reads any file under 50KB whose name matches wallet, key, secret, seed, mnemonic, keystore, or private (including.json/.pem/.key files). The collected contents, along with the hostname and username, are POSTed as JSON to the hardcoded endpoint https://enxhcjpo5ev.x.pipedream.net/c.
